body: Founder: 'on camels' -> clarified via AskUserQuestion as CAMELS bank rating -> 'as a blog post not in French'. Real constraint found before writing: CAMELS ratings are confidential regulatory data (Fed/FDIC/OCC examiner-assigned, never publicly disclosed) -- fabricating or estimating one for a real bank would look exactly like real sourced content while actually being an unfounded guess, directly against TINA's own doctrine. Wrote the honest version instead: what CAMELS actually is, why TINA won't produce one, and real filing-date data for JPM/BAC/WFC/C/GS/MS/SCHW checked directly against the event store (JPM/BAC/WFC/C all filed 8-Ks 2026-07-14, matching real mid-July bank earnings season timing). Full disclosure block included. https://okemily.com/blog/tina-camels-what-we-wont-claim-to-know/
title: TINA: CAMELS -- What We Won't Claim to Know
